items.title: China’s military seeks Nvidia’s advanced chips for AI capabilities, commission says
items.summary: A congressional commission issued its findings as Nvidia has been rocked by its CEO's resignation after reports he had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

items.title: Nvidia Remains Optimistic and Raises Outlook After CEO Scandal
Nvidia Looks Past Jensen Huang With Raised Outlook, Strong Earnings
Nvidia Raises Outlook, Peltola Wins Alaska Senate Race, More
Asian Stocks Waver After Nvidia Results
items.summary: Asian stocks wavered as investors looked past Nvidia’s better-than-expected results and continued to show caution on the AI sector outlook. Winnie Hsu reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: 'Who and what comes next': Analysts expect Nvidia investor uncertainty despite earnings beat
items.summary: Nvidia’s Q3 results should help ease short-term concerns, but uncertainty remains around long-term leadership.

items.title: Peltola Wins Alaska Senate Race, Nvidia Raises Outlook, More
With Jensen Huang gone, Colette Kress shows Nvidia is still at the center of AI
items.summary: In her first earnings report as interim CEO, Nvidia's Colette Kress calmed investors' nerves, at least for the moment.

items.title: Analysts are cautiously optimistic on Nvidia after earnings call
items.summary: A raise in revenue guidance and a clear decision on leadership sat well with the Street, though dealmaking scrutiny could temper enthusiasm.

items.title: Nvidia's Colette Kress tells Cramer: Employees and customers are not going anywhere
items.summary: Interim CEO Colette Kress said exclusively on "Mad Money" that the chipmaker's customers and employees remain committed to the company.
